newsitem.title: UK: ROWING-LEANDER CLUB VOTE TO ADMIT WOMEN.
newsitem.headline: ROWING-LEANDER CLUB VOTE TO ADMIT WOMEN.

text.p: Leander, the oldest rowing club in the world, have voted to drop a 179-year ban on women members in order to qualify for national lottery money.
"A special general meeting of Leander Club held on Sunday 27 April voted by a clear majority to admit women as members," said a statement from committee chairman Chris Rodrigues.
The English club now become eligible for 1.5 million ($2.4 million) of British lottery money.
Previously women were admitted to the clubhouse only as members' guests.

Steve Redgrave and Matthew Pinsent, who won Britain's only title at last year's Atlanta Olympics with their victory in the coxless pairs, are members of the club which is situated at Henley-on-Thames.
